# Zenvylo

> A lead desk for freelancers and small agencies who sell digital services to
> local businesses. It finds real businesses, measures their public websites,
> remembers the measurements, and tells you what changed. Each prospect can
> have a proof page the business owner can open and check.

The site is https://zenvylo.app.

## What a chatbot cannot do

A chat assistant can draft a cold email from a description you paste in.
Zenvylo does three things that require a product, not a conversation:

1. It fetches the website and records what is there: HTTPS, mobile viewport,
   response time, title, search description, tap-to-call, contact form,
   booking link, analytics, structured data, footer year, and whether the
   page loaded at all.
2. It stores that measurement on the lead. A later re-check diffs the two
   fetches and lists what changed, citing both observations. A scheduled job
   can re-check saved sites; a change shows on the Today desk only when the
   new measurement differs from the stored one.
3. On Pro, Ask your desk is a model that calls tools over that user's saved
   leads, checks, watch log, and pipeline. A fact has to cite a stored
   measurement. Below Pro, or when no model key is set, the same box answers
   from those records directly. It does not send email.
4. It builds a proof page. The link contains the measurements. The code on
   the page is a hash of them. Editing the link makes the code stop matching.

Scores are computed in code from those checks, weighted for the service you
sell. Outreach drafts, on paid plans, are told to cite only those checks.
The product refuses to state revenue, traffic, or competitor claims it has
not measured.

Neighbour comparisons use the same measurement on nearby businesses of the
same OpenStreetMap category.

## Who it's for

Freelance web designers, SEO consultants, and small agencies doing local
outreach. Anyone selling a digital service to bricks-and-mortar businesses.

## How it works

1. Pick what you sell (twelve presets, or type your own).
2. Pick a country and optionally a city.
3. Zenvylo pulls businesses from OpenStreetMap. Listings are
   © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
4. It fetches and measures each website.
5. Findings and a 0–100 score are computed from those measurements.
6. You keep the leads in a pipeline, set follow-up dates, and re-check them.
7. On Pro and above, Claude can draft outreach from the verified findings.

CSV import costs no scans and runs the same measurement pipeline.

## Pricing

- Free — 3 scans/month, 5 leads per scan
- Starter, $9/mo — 20 scans/month
- Growth, $19/mo — 50 scans/month, all countries
- Pro, $39/mo — 100 scans/month, AI drafts that cite measurements
- Scale, $79/mo — 200 scans/month
- Enterprise — contact hello@zenvylo.app
